title: Other work
titleFull: Other work: ceramics, sculpture and drawing | Phào Design
description: Ceramic sculpture, vessels, pencil drawing and handmade pieces made alongside the main projects.
summary: Ceramic sculpture, vessels, pencil drawing and handmade pieces made alongside the main projects, most of them made by hand from start to finish.
heroAlt: A pencil still life of bottles, fruit and a mortar on draped cloth
altImageAlt: Lotus flowers and leaves painted in colour

chapters.heading: Ceramics and sculpture
body: The ceramic pieces are formed by hand, among them an owl and several twisting forms taken from the shape of a wave. This work began during the internship at Bien Hoa Ceramics and carried on afterwards.
The vessels and pots use a running glaze, so each firing comes out a different shade.

images.caption: The owl, modelled by hand and still unfired.

images.alt: A twisting clay form taken from the shape of a wave
images.caption: A twisting form worked up from the shape of a wave.

images.alt: A glazed ceramic vessel holding a flowering arrangement
images.caption: Fired and glazed, in use as a vase.

images.alt: Two people throwing a pot on the wheel in the workshop
images.caption: Throwing on the wheel; most of the work here is done by hand.

chapters.heading: Drawing
body: Portraits and still life in pencil, lotus studies in colour. Drawing by hand is the ground the concept sketching in the product projects stands on.

images.alt: A pencil portrait part-finished, with the hand and pencil still on the sheet
images.caption: A portrait in progress.

images.alt: Lotus flowers and leaves painted in colour
images.caption: Lotus studies, painted rather than drawn.

chapters.heading: Craft and teaching
body: There is also leatherwork, measured, cut and stitched by hand, and drawing and modelling classes for young children at Art Class For Kids and Tao Hong 2 Kindergarten.

images.alt: Small leather pieces with metal fittings, laid out on a light ground
images.caption: Leather pieces, measured, cut and stitched by hand.
